title: Battle of Fehmarn (1715)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Fehmarn (1715)", at revision 1377869650, opens: "The Battle of Fehmarn was a naval battle took place on 24 April 1715 (N.S.), during the Great Northern War. It was a victory for a Danish squadron under Gabel, which captured five of the six Swedish ships under Wachtmeister at the cost of 66 dead and 226 wounded." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q1780316, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1715 naval battle during the Great Northern War". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
